author: Scott Demyon
text: I HATE the alarms, so I built a companion app that reads your level and trend out loud to you every 1, 2, 3, 5 or 10 minutes. Now, I can take insulin or eat something WAY before the alarms hit. "Libre Beacon" on Google and "Glucose Beacon" on iOS.

author: Tom Barca
text: I turned off the alarms as they got annoying especially at the 2am low
